tools.name: list_demo_wallets
tools.description: List the fixed public wallets, snapshot dates and recorded coverage.

tools.name: get_holdings
tools.description: Read one listed wallet's precomputed report, paginated; never scan or refresh.

tools.name: retrieve_holdings
tools.description: Retrieve saved sample assets, quantities and values; same data as get_holdings.

tools.name: get_historical_price
tools.description: Read a recorded sample price by symbol or exact contract; no market lookup.

tools.name: export_holdings_csv
tools.description: Export every sample asset, quantity and USD value as CSV, including unpriced tokens.

tools.name: get_demo_guide
tools.description: Explain fixed-snapshot scope and how to connect the separate paid service.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "retrieve_holdings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Retrieve recorded sample positions with provenance; same fixed data as get_holdings." → after: "Retrieve saved sample assets, quantities and values; same data as get_holdings."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "export_holdings_csv" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Export all positions from a fixed sample as safe CSV, including price/verification evidence." → after: "Export every sample asset, quantity and USD value as CSV, including unpriced tokens."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
